title: Confluence over clutter
desc: Combine trend, level and volume instead of stacking indicators

cards.title: Five out of five
cards.situation: You have RSI, Stochastic, CCI, Williams %R and Ultimate Oscillator on your chart. All five say “oversold”. How strong is that evidence?

options.text: Very strong: five out of five agree
options.feedback: All five are momentum gauges built from the same prices. Five copies of one opinion is still one opinion.

options.text: About one signal: they all measure the same thing
options.feedback: They all ask the same question: did price fall fast? One yes, said five times.
They’re not worthless: they agree that price fell fast. But they all read the same prices, so count it as about one signal.

cards.work: 5 momentum gauges, 1 input: recent prices. 5 copies of 1 view.

cards.title: Different questions, not more answers
cards.text: **[[confluence|Confluence]]** means several different kinds of evidence agree. Each one has to answer a different question.

items.title: Trend
items.text: Which way? Higher lows, price above a rising 50-day.

items.title: Volume
items.text: Who’s behind it? Above-normal volume on the move.

blocks.tip: When trend, level and volume all agree, that’s confluence.

cards.title: A setup with confluence
cards.text: An uptrend pulls back to $58. That’s old support, and the 50-day average sits there too.

chart.label: An uptrend pulls back to $58 support and the rising 50-day, with 2× volume on the bounce

cards.title: Clean chart, clear head
cards.text: One tool per question. If two tools always agree, **delete one**. And even with confluence, you still use a stop.

cards.title: Pick the extra check
cards.q: Price bounces off support in an uptrend. You already have RSI. Which check adds new information?

options.text: Stochastic, to go with your RSI
options.feedback: Stochastic and RSI both measure momentum from the same prices. Volume answers a new question: who’s behind the bounce.
Volume answers a question RSI can’t: who’s behind the bounce. That’s new information.

options.text: A second RSI with other settings
options.feedback: A second RSI reads the same prices the same way. It repeats what you already know.
Another average repeats the trend question you’ve already answered. Volume answers a new one: who’s behind the bounce.

cards.title: Real confluence
cards.q: Which of these setups has real confluence?

options.text: RSI, Stochastic and CCI all oversold
options.feedback: Three momentum gauges repeat one view. Trend, level and volume answer three different questions.

options.text: Uptrend, bounce at support, high volume
options.feedback: Trend, level and volume each answer a different question. When all three agree, that’s confluence.
Three averages all answer the same question: which way? That’s one view repeated.

options.text: MACD and its bars both turning up
options.feedback: The bars are built from the MACD line itself. They repeat one view, so that isn’t confluence.

cards.headline: You can build a clean chart.
lines: Indicators built from the same prices repeat each other.
Combine trend, level and volume: three different questions.
Confluence raises the odds. It never replaces the stop.
